decisions.title: Character Origin-Rarity rates
decisions.verified_observation: Six grades R/SR/SSR/UR/LR/MR approved. Existing 1.2% top candidate; no six-grade baseline in frozen docs.
decisions.proposed_recommendation: For full six-tier MR-top standard limited banner: 65% R, 18% SR, 9% SSR, 4.5% UR, 2.3% LR, 1.2% MR. Bind table to actual approved eligible pool only.
decisions.alternatives: B: 54/25/12/5.5/2.3/1.2 for more access; C: 72/15/7/3/1.8/1.2 for higher scarcity.
sources: Original v0.40 master; Gate00 2026-10-13 final Gate10 UI design acceptance; https://github.com/Azrazieliz/Offline-Game/blob/3f54f07cacbf193e160d0be15a7be5a7bc730c3b/Source/OfflineGame/Public/Characters/OGCharacterDefinitions.h

fixed_constraints: The six-grade table is not globally applicable: only a specifically approved all-six, MR-top standard limited banner.

Absolute Transcendence is not a seventh acquisition rarity.
decisions.review_annotation: Selected six-tier Proposal A, not the alternate profiles; requires Gate00 canonical acceptance and an actual eligible MR-top all-six content pool before live use.

decisions.title: Soft pity, hard pity and featured guarantee
decisions.verified_observation: Service multiplies top entry weight after 50; freeze demands +5 absolute percentage points per pull 51–69. Featured 50/50 is not guaranteed by arbitrary authored weights.
decisions.proposed_recommendation: Gate12 use integer bps tier-first sampling: top(n)=120 bps through 50, 120+500*(n-50) bps 51–69, 10000 at 70. Lower tiers proportional to configured base; featured top 50/50 then guaranteed after miss. Maintain category carry.
decisions.alternatives: Alternative implementation can be equivalent fixed-point math, provided exact probabilities and deterministic RNG remain verified.
decisions.authorized_now: Prepare production specifications / request Gate00 routing; do not alter canonical content or saves
fixed_constraints: Soft pity uses +500 absolute bps for each ordinal 51-69; hard 70.
Featured 50/50 then guarantee; pity/category carry.
Do not change frozen tuning without Gate00.
decisions.review_annotation: Approval applies to source-correct additive bps sampling and exact 50/50 logic; Gate12 change pending; frozen tuning not rebalanced.

decisions.title: Ten-pull minimum and atomic batch
decisions.verified_observation: PullBatch 1–10 exists but no SR+ floor; existing transaction encompasses batch.
decisions.proposed_recommendation: Gate12 apply the frozen SR+ ten-pull floor only on authored eligible ten-pull banners. Proposed minimum perturbation: if all ten rolled R, upgrade the last result to an eligible SR grade, leaving top-rarity roll and pity unchanged. All payment and manifestations commit atomically.
decisions.alternatives: Alternative: constrained SR+ roll on tenth; changes higher-rarity marginal rates and requires exact published probabilities.

decisions.review_annotation: Deferred choice is how an eligible 10-pull guarantees SR+, not whether the frozen floor exists. Do not deploy an unfloored applicable ten-pull.

decisions.title: Ticket taxonomy and payment priority
decisions.verified_observation: Ordinary one-pull ticket list and ticket-first payment exist; no complete typed multi/guaranteed/selector execution contracts in reviewed service.
decisions.proposed_recommendation: Keep authored CompatibleTicketIds order for ordinary payments; separate ticket-kind execution contracts: single, multi, event/dimensional, guarantee/restricted, exceptional selector. Never expire by default. Quote exact debits and pity routing.
decisions.alternatives: Alternative special ticket presentation order; special ticket semantics must remain explicitly authored, never inferred from name.
decisions.authorized_now: Prepare production specifications / request Gate00 routing; do not alter canonical content or saves
fixed_constraints: Compatible ordinary tickets are spent first automatically; special guaranteed/selector routes must be authored.
Ordinary tickets advance ordinary pity; no automatic expiry.
No new core pull currency.
decisions.review_annotation: Ticket-family contract is accepted, but no ticket IDs, entitlement, balances, pools, or exceptions are approved from this choice.

decisions.title: Currency, wallet, ledger and recovery

decisions.alternatives: Alternative use authoritative event log as ledger index if it satisfies exact balance delta and replay uniqueness.

decisions.review_annotation: Defer enhancement details (quote API/idempotency/ledger shape), not frozen payment atomicity or accurate pre-execution payment display. Disable transaction UI if exact payment cannot be confirmed.

decisions.title: Acquisition income, sources, sinks and farming
decisions.verified_observation: Frozen simulator bands 4–8,7–14,14–27,27–52+ pull-equivalents/hour are NOT mandated wages or player-level multipliers. No complete authored reward source catalog verified.
decisions.proposed_recommendation: Use source-attached reward definitions for exploration, quests, production, dispatch, challenges, and higher-order farms; renewable source must exist even late game. Model pull EV incl tickets; verify no zero-access deadlock or repeat-sell inflation.
decisions.alternatives: Alternative relative source mixes after Gate02/05/06/08 world content, but never hidden progression payout multipliers.
decisions.authorized_now: Prepare production specifications / request Gate00 routing; do not alter canonical content or saves
fixed_constraints: No universal player-tier income multiplier or hidden fixed weekly wages.
A real, renewable acquisition source must exist in the persistent World.
decisions.review_annotation: Approval to model actual gameplay sources and sinks; reward amounts and world content remain authored/approved separately.

decisions.alternatives: Alternative catalogs: regional survival/feudal craft vs occult relic vs mixed cultural kits, requiring Gate00 direction before canon.
decisions.authorized_now: Prepare production specifications / request Gate00 routing; do not alter canonical content or saves
fixed_constraints: Item Quality, current Item Rank and character Origin/Current Rarity remain independent.
No canonical item IDs, item assets or regional cultures invented from the approval of a catalog process.
decisions.review_annotation: Approval to prepare a 15+ item/three-family source-grade proposed catalog, not approval of actual item identities or material families. Requires Gate02/Gate06 environment/faction constraints.

Keep functional item state distinct from skin/clothing.

fixed_constraints: Body-specific compatible slots; worn items visible and actual outfit layers preserved.
No simultaneous use of a unique physical item without a valid explicit mechanism.

fixed_constraints: No durability chore loop; damage/repair causally meaningful; no generic weapon-feeding recipe.
